topic: Total cost of a birthday dinner with tip
core_question: A birthday dinner bill is $90. The group adds a 20% tip. What is the total amount paid, in dollars? (secondary: You pay for $63.20 in groceries using two $20 bills and one $30 bill. How much change do you receive?)
answer_summary: the total of $108 ($90 bill plus a 20% tip); after the topic shift: $6.80 in change (from $70 minus $63.20)
persona: anxious and rambling; chatty and verbose
